slides.needs: heavy bag swinging in empty dark gym
slides.text: How to hit harder without lifting heavier...
Turn your back foot like you're crushing a bug. Power starts from the floor.

slides.needs: boxer throwing a cross, shot from behind
slides.text: Rotate your hips before your arm moves. The arm goes last.
Stay loose until the moment of contact. Tension slows the punch down.
Punch through the target, not at it. Aim 4 inches behind it.
